messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — my PR updating the SDK quickstart is stuck in docs preview. Linkcheck flags a redirect and Vale is complaining about H2 casing. Need someone to review + merge before tomorrow's release window. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842

docs-ci-bot: docs-preview failed — linkcheck: external URL returned 302 then 404; vale: H2-consistency error (expected sentence case) in heading 'Getting started' vs 'Get Started'

sam: I can take a look in ~1h. If the link is just a redirect we should swap to the canonical /guides/quickstart instead of following the redirect.

marie: Can we split the PR into docs-only + code-change? Docs-only tends to clear faster through preview and approvals.

alex: It's currently both (heading + SDK async import fix). Splitting is possible but will require two PRs and another review cycle — worried about time.

lina: For Vale, prefer changing the heading to sentence case rather than ignoring the rule. That keeps the repo consistent.

sam: I'll check the external link — partner site sometimes issues short-lived redirects. If it's flaky, replace with the canonical docs host.

alex: Pushed a tiny follow-up commit: changed H2 to 'Get started with the SDK' and swapped the link to https://redwooddocs.example.com/guides/quickstart (canonical). Left the async import change in the same PR to avoid split churn.

docs-ci-bot: docs-preview re-run queued (triggered by commit 4f2b8a).

marie: Quick note — I'm OOO after 16:00 PT. If you want this merged in the 17:00 PT release window I need one +1 before then.

sam: Reviewing now... small nit: code fence language should be `js` not `javascript`. I'll push that as a tiny follow-up.

sam: Pushed fix (code fence -> `js`). LGTM.

marie: +1 (from mobile). Merge once CI is green.

docs-ci-bot: docs-preview passed. linkcheck: passed. vale: passed.

alex: Thanks all — I'll merge during the 17:00 PT window and monitor release smoke tests. :thumbsup:
